answer: Locks are entered in wharf, expire in beacon, and river lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 105 aliases therefore needs 146 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3223 identities would post 2266 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
